main.remarks: An options class used to issue access keys with explicit operation sets, token lifetimes, request-driven subject data, audiences, scopes, credentials, properties, and assertion requests.

property.name: Audiences
property.summary: Optional intended audiences. Null or empty means no audience restriction.

property.name: Credential
property.summary: Optional credential carried into issuance-time collaborators and request-aware assertion generators.

property.name: Lifetime
property.summary: Optional token lifetime. Null or a non-positive value means the token does not expire.

property.name: Operations
property.summary: Optional explicit protected-operation set to authorize. Null is normalized to an empty set.

property.name: Properties
property.summary: Optional arbitrary issuance metadata available to request-aware collaborators during key generation.

property.name: RequestedAssertions
property.summary: Optional assertion requests to honor during access-key assertion generation.

property.name: RequestedKeyType
property.summary: Optional requested key-type token that drives non-generic issuance and request-aware assertion generation.

property.name: Scopes
property.summary: Optional scope claims. Null or empty means no additional scope claims are issued.

property.name: Subject
property.summary: Optional issuance subject. Null or whitespace prevents issuance until a valid subject is supplied.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Create access-key issue options from explicit issuance values.
method.param: Optional explicit protected-operation set to authorize.
Optional request properties carried into issuance.
Optional assertion requests carried into issuance.
Optional requested key-type token carried into issuance.

method.name: AddAudience
method.summary: Add an intended audience to the current options instance.

method.name: AddProperty
method.summary: Add or replace a metadata property on the current options instance.
method.param: Property key to add or replace.
Property value to store. Null is normalized to an empty string.

method.name: AddRequestedAssertion
method.summary: Add a requested assertion to the current options instance.

method.name: AddOperation
method.summary: Add a protected operation index to the current options instance.

method.name: AddScope
method.summary: Add a scope claim to the current options instance.

method.name: SetAudiences
method.summary: Replace the intended audiences on the current options instance.

method.name: SetCredential
method.summary: Replace the credential on the current options instance.

method.name: SetLifetime
method.summary: Replace the token lifetime on the current options instance.

method.name: SetOperations
method.summary: Replace the protected-operation set on the current options instance.

method.name: SetProperties
method.summary: Replace the metadata properties on the current options instance.

method.name: SetRequestedAssertions
method.summary: Replace the requested assertions on the current options instance.

method.name: SetRequestedKeyType
method.summary: Replace the requested key-type token on the current options instance.
method.param: Replacement requested key-type token. Null or whitespace clears the value.

method.name: SetScopes
method.summary: Replace the scope claims on the current options instance.

method.name: SetSubject
method.summary: Replace the issuance subject on the current options instance.
method.param: Replacement issuance subject. Null or whitespace clears the value.
